headlines.title: Watch: Judge declares mistrial in Lindsay Clancy trial, thanks jury for service
headlines.description: Judge William Sullivan declared a mistrial in the Lindsay Clancy case after the jury failed to reach a unanimous verdict.

headlines.title: How vote breakdown of Clancy jury will influence legal strategy in potential retrial
headlines.description: NBC News' Danny Cevallos and Laura Jarrett discuss the Lindsay Clancy mistrial and how both the defense and prosecution will approach a potential retrial.

headlines.title: Will Lindsay Clancy be retried? How and when it could happen
headlines.description: Judge William Sullivan declared a mistrial Friday after the jury weighing the fate of Lindsay Clancy failed for the third time to reach a verdict in the case. NBC News' Laura Jarrett and Misty Marris discuss when the Massachusetts mother could face another trial.

headlines.title: Maria Bartiromo’s lawyer says she was not fired from Fox News
headlines.description: Maria Bartiromo’s lawyer on Friday said that the Fox News and Fox Business anchor was not fired from the company where she worked for more than 12 years.

headlines.title: 2 Workers Rescued From Nepal Tunnel 9 Days After Floods
headlines.description: Two workers have been pulled alive from a hydropower tunnel buried by debris, nine days after the catastrophic floods in Nepal. NBC’s Janis Mackey Frayer reports for TODAY on the remarkable details of the rescue and the ongoing search for other possible survivors.

headlines.title: A first of its kind organ transplant technique tried on a human subject
headlines.description: Meet the first-ever patient to receive stem cells from their donor, in the hope of avoiding toxic anti-rejection drugs. NBC News' Camila Bernal spoke to the patient who received a liver transplant from her sister.

headlines.title: I found 150+ Labor Day sales that are actually worth shopping — deals are up to 75% off
headlines.description: Labor Day 2026 is on Sept. 7, but deals are already here. Get up to 75% off Amazon, Home Depot, Wayfair, Lowe’s and REI, plus learn expert-approved savings tips.

headlines.title: Halloween Chocolatey Eyeballs Candy Recalled Over Allergy Risks
headlines.description: New Jersey candy company Little Temptations has recalled their popular “chocolatey eyeballs” because of undeclared milk allergens. The candy is sold at major retailers including Marshalls, TJ Maxx, and Home Goods in 13 states.

headlines.title: Texas AG Paxton investigates military healthcare contractor over denied claims
headlines.description: Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton has opened an investigation into a major military healthcare contractor over wrongfully denied medical claims.

headlines.title: Supreme Court backs Republicans in election ad rate dispute
headlines.description: Republicans asked the high court to allow party committees to receive the same ad discounts that candidates themselves benefit from.

headlines.title: Serbia accused of ‘glorifying’ convicted war criminal Ratko Mladić ahead of funeral
headlines.description: BELGRADE, Serbia — The European Union’s Enlargement Commissioner Marta Kos on Friday canceled an upcoming visit to candidate nation Serbia over what she described as the “glorification” of former Bosnian Serb army commander Ratko Mladić following his death.
